Bahadur dil free dil hota hai.
Khali bartan sabse zyada shor karte hain.
Himmat sabko prerit karti hai.
Andar se bahadur bano.
Jab chhodna ho, tab bhi chalte raho.
Asli taqat rooh ki khamoshi mein hai.
Doubt ke bawajood kaam karna—himmat.
Himmat victory ki shuruaat hai.
Silence emptiness nahi; purpose wali pause hai.
Hausla aur himmat ek saath—jore ki tarah.
Goals pe atak ke raho—stubborn.
Grit hai long-term goals ke liye passion aur perseverance.
Asafalta se asafalta tak bina josh khoye badhte rehna hi safalta hai.
Grit kathin hai.
Khamoshi—God ki language hai.
Khamoshi wisdom ki breathing hai.
Courage insaan ki pehli quality hai, kyunki yahi baaki sabko guarantee karti hai.
Bravery darr ke saath move karna hai.
Courage—fear ka na hona nahi, uske bawajood act karne ki ability.
